summary: Defined ways to cut the gap in connectivity when a Mobile IPv6 device moves between access routers. During handover, link switching and the standard protocol steps leave a period when the device cannot send or receive. The document set up procedures to anticipate and shorten that delay. It was replaced by RFC 5568.

eli5.summary: When you switch between two Wi-Fi hotspots, your video call freezes for a moment. This was a plan for getting ready for the move beforehand, so the call hardly stops. It has since been replaced by RFC 5568.
